hero.title: The Glass Fortress Manifesto
hero.subtitle: A decentralised, blockchain-protected legal evidence platform for building a class-action lawsuit against COVID-19 health policy failures.

mission.title: The Mission
mission.p1: We are building a multi-dimensional legal case against public health authorities who concealed, misled, and coerced — during the COVID-19 crisis.
mission.p2: Our platform lets citizens, doctors, and whistleblowers submit evidence with full anonymity. The AI classifies, summarises, and tiers each submission.

blockchain.title: The Blockchain Guarantee
blockchain.p1: We do NOT store files on the blockchain — only a digital fingerprint: a SHA-256 hash of the file. Every piece of evidence receives an immutable timestamp on the Arbitrum network.
blockchain.p2: The cryptographic timestamp proves in court that a document existed and was unchanged from that moment — defeating any deepfake or forgery claim.
blockchain.footer: The record is independent and immutable — no single party can delete it.

vault.title: The Dark Vault — Your Privacy
vault.p1: The blockchain is fully anonymous. Your name is never recorded there. The file itself is not stored.
vault.p2: If you choose to leave contact details, they are AES-256 encrypted in the 'Dark Vault' — a physically isolated database with no public internet access.
vault.item3: Legal access only, with your consent

trust.heading: Why Trust Us
trust.badge1: Open source — every line of code is auditable
trust.badge3: Full anonymity — no account, no registration
trust.badge4: AES-256 encryption for all sensitive data
trust.badge5: No central server — decentralised and resilient

cta.title: Have evidence? Time to submit it.
cta.body: Any document, screenshot, or testimony — even if it seems small — could be the link that completes the case. Anonymous submission. No registration required.
cta.hint: Questions? Click the chat bubble and the Trust Agent will help.

forensics.tagline: Wayback Machine Forensic Diff · Silent Edits Exposed
forensics.scanDescription: Enter an official government or health authority URL. We will fetch all archived versions from the Wayback Machine, diff them, and cross-reference any changes with our internal evidence database to expose silent cover-up edits.
forensics.scanningHint: Fetching archive snapshots and running forensic analysis. This may take 1–3 minutes.
forensics.noChangesSub: All archive snapshots for this URL contain identical content or only cosmetic edits.
forensics.noSnapshotsSub: The Wayback Machine has no records for this URL.

forensics.scanPausedSub: Progress is saved. Resume at any time to continue from where it stopped.
forensics.identicalContent: No text changes recorded for this version.
